jobs.title: Stenotypist
jobs.description:
Intermediate
Minimum speed of 80/40 w.p.m in shorthand/typing respectively.
Computer literate will be given preference.
Terms and Conditions
Interested candidates shall apply online on website www.njp.gov.pk within 15 days of date of publication of advertisement.
Interested candidates are requested to appear before the Selection Committee constituted for the purpose for walk-in interviews which will be communicated at later date.
The condition of technical skills can be relaxed till completion of probation period.
Preference will be given to 12 districts of Southern Balochistan.
Provision of original documents shall be mandatory at the time of interview.
Incomplete applications shall not be entertained.
Serving Government employees shall apply through proper channel.
Women and minorities are encouraged to apply.
Selected candidates will be posted in Islamabad.
No TA/DA will be admissible for the purpose of test/Interview.
Information provided in the application form will be verified in case of offer of appointment. In case of any false or forged information, Finance Division reserves the right to cancel candidature at any stage (even after employment, if so discovered later) and will initiate a legal action against the applicant.
Finance Division (Main) reserves the right to increase/decrease the number of posts at any stage, subject to their availability.

jobs.title: Stenotypist
jobs.description:
Qualification: Intermediate. Shorthand/Typing with minimum speed of 80/40 WPM and Computer literate
Job Location: Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, Islamabad
Job Description: Taking dictation, rendering transcripts and doing general typing work; Attending to receipt and issue work during the absence of the Section Assistant; and Any other ancillary function and work that may be assigned by the officer, e.g. reproduction of documents, arranging office amenities etc.

jobs.title: Assistant
jobs.description:
(a) putting up previous papers and other references relating to
the case under consideration;
(b) opening of files and keeping a record of movement of files;
(c) keeping a note of all important orders and decisions;
(d) recording, indexing and weeding of files;
(e) watching the necessity of keeping priority or security labels
on files. He should bring to the notice of the Section Officer
the first opportunity that occurs of removing these labels;
and
(f) other clerical duties assigned to him, including casual
typing, maintenance of diary register, preparation of
statements and putting up of routine reminders.

All recruitments to be done by Walk-in-interview (No Entry & No Written Test).
Interested candidates are requested to appear before the Seclection Committee constituted for the purpose for walk-in-inetrviews which will be communicated at later date.
The condition of technical skills can be relaxed till completion of probation period.
Provision of original documents shall be mandatory at the time of interview.
Upper age relaxation of 5 years instead of existing 3 years, in addition to 5 years general age relaxation.
The candidates having Balochistan domiciles who fulfill the prescribed qualification/experience mentioined against the post may apply through National Job Portal (hxxp[://]www[.]njp[.]gov[.]pk).
Those who are already in Government service must apply “Through Proper Channel”.
Women are encouraged to apply.
Selected candidate will be posted in Islamabad.
In case, the candidate has no certification at the time of the seclection, the selected candidate shall acquire the prescribed proficiency through departmental on-the-job training after joining within probation period. Their proficiency shall be assessed before confirmation, and failure to acquire it shall be dealt with under the applicable probation and service rules.
Incomplete applications and those received after due date shall not be entertained.
